title: Period calculation
description: Essential: The response must correctly compute the period using T = 2π√(LC) and give the numerical value with units.

title: Charge polarity at t
description: Essential: The response must state that the upper plate is negatively charged at t = 2.0 ms.

title: Current direction at t
description: Essential: The response must state the current direction is counterclockwise at t = 2.0 ms.

title: Average current magnitude
description: Essential: The response must correctly compute the average current as I_avg = Q_max / (T/4) and give the numerical value with units.

title: Physics of LC oscillation
description: Important: The response must correctly relate the given time to the phase of the oscillation (e.g., t = 2.0 ms is between T/4 and T/2).

title: Maximum charge from voltage
description: Important: The response must use Q_max = C * V_max to find the maximum charge on the capacitor.

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the charge polarity or current direction is reversed, or if units are missing/incorrect in final answers.

title: Formula misapplication
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the wrong formula is used for period (e.g., forgetting 2π) or average current (e.g., using I_max).
